authority: owner-ratified D8 domain width/ontology only (issue 2410, 2026-10-03). Occupancy below is AGENT-DERIVED EVIDENCE, not owner-ratified semantic authority: #2410 states that a D8 coordinate does not become occupied/callable without the relevant ratified law/witness, and that a PR occupancy map does not replace owner semantic authority.
description: Full chronological early-Lisp capability occupancy of Domain 8 following D6 parents, applying the ratified D3-D6 occupancy rule at width 8.

method.occupancy_rule: A D8 coordinate is a D6 coordinate extended by two bits: each of the 64 D6 coordinates has exactly four D8 children, exactly as each D4 coordinate had two D5 children and each D5 coordinate had two D6 children.
method.selector_rule: The 64 selector coordinates are generated by the admitted D3 law (roots 101=CAR, 110=CDR; appended 0 composes CAR, appended 1 composes CDR). They are never hand-written; all 16 D6 selector parents have four selector children, which reproduces exactly the D8 selector forecast of #2322.
method.historical_rule: FALSIFIED AND DEMOTED. The earlier rule assigned four chronological historical Lisp capabilities per D6 parent. Factor-analysis showed it does not factor into two independent commuting policies the way #2506 does, so it is not a law. Its 192 coordinates are now attested-not-admitted candidates whose provenance is preserved, not occupants.
method.lineage_note: D8 continues the D4->D5->D6 historical rung as a two-bit extension, because D7 is not a member of that rung: knowledge/d7-full-map.json records that D7 is NOT a one-bit extension of a parent domain and owns the Text7/Sound7 articulatory law instead. Every D8 coordinate therefore records parent_d6 as its lineage parent and parent_d7 as the mechanical one-bit prefix. Width is part of identity, so a 7-bit sound cell and its 8-bit D8 children are distinct identities; the lineage does not import the D7 law (#2497).

ratification_scope.precedent: #2415 (ratified D7): 'Ratification covers the domain width/ontology and semantic role, not blanket occupancy of all 128 coordinates.' The same boundary is applied to D8.
ratified: lineage = each D6 coordinate has exactly four D8 children
not_ratified: any individual coordinate assignment outside the admitted selector law

non_conflation.rule: D8 is an exact 8-bit Core domain. Legacy Sens8 is an 8-bit flat byte table where the byte is simultaneously address and identity. Equal width does not imply shared type or shared law, and neither domain implies the other.
non_conflation.precedent: #2415: Sound7 cells and local sloka/sutra ordinals both use seven-bit values without implying one arithmetic Number type or law.
non_conflation.measured_overlap: 8 of 183 legacy Sens8 EN surface names also appear in this map, and none of the eight shares a coordinate with its legacy byte (for example APPLY is Sens8 10101111 but D8 00001100). D8 is not a relabelled byte table.

falsified_rules.rule: four chronological historical Lisp capabilities per D6 parent
falsified_rules.falsifier: the four children of a parent do not factor into two independent commuting policies
falsified_rules.worked_counterexample: D6 000001 LOAD -> OPEN, CLOSE, WITH-OPEN-FILE, DRIBBLE. OPEN and CLOSE are two poles of one operation, not two instances of one refinement, so no commuting square exists.
falsified_rules.second_counterexample: D6 000011 CURRY -> APPLY, COMPOSE, PARTIAL, FFI-CALL. A foreign-function call is not a curry descendant, so the rule produced a category error.
falsified_rules.action: 192 coordinates demoted to attested-not-admitted; provenance kept

next_step.method: Derive remaining coordinates one admitted law at a time. Each D8 cell needs two independent one-bit refinements of its D6 parent plus an executable witness that the refinements commute, exactly as #2506 did for D6. Historical Lisp functions then become positive controls, not allocations.
next_step.progress_metric: count of independent admitted laws that earned inhabitants, NOT occupancy out of 256

honesty.selector_rows: generated by an admitted law, not by allocation
honesty.historical_rows: NOT admitted. These are attested-but-unadmitted candidates whose provenance is preserved as witness material. A chronological capability list is not a law, and ADR-005 §4 requires an executable witness before a primitive earns a semantic identity. They are kept visible so the witness material is not lost, and are not counted as occupancy.
honesty.occupancy_claim_withdrawn: This map no longer claims full 256/256 occupancy. Claiming unallocated=0 asserted blanket occupancy, which #2415 explicitly declines to ratify.
honesty.residency: Occupancy does not claim semantic irreducibility. Derivability is tracked separately under #2765.
honesty.not_authority: A coordinate in this map is an occupancy claim under the D3-D6 rule, not a ratified language contract. Language authority stays in language-contract.lisp.
